description:
Advances: specled.mix_tasks

From the pre-ship critical review, consensus finding CF2 (security + spec reviewers), calibrated Medium. Cheapest to fix NOW, before anything parses the new field.

Three pre-flight rejection sites in lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex (~:71, :121, :295, :312) hardcode tier: "validate", error_findings: 0 for failures that occur BEFORE validation is attempted. Verified by execution: mix spec.check --base <bad-ref> emits `spec.check result=fail tier=validate error_findings=0` and NO `validate status=` line at all — the verdict asserts a validation-tier failure on a run where validation never started.

Fourth collision from the other direction: spec.check always validates with strict: true, so a run failing purely on warnings also reports error_findings=0. The suite pins the identical string for a substantive failure (spec_tasks_test.exs:606) and a pure usage error (:931).

This is a spec defect before a code defect: the grammar `tier=<validate|branch>` has no honest token for "the task never started."

Fix: add a third tier token (tier=invocation or tier=usage) to the verdict_line requirement grammar and emit it from the pre-flight sites; either add warning_findings=<N> or state explicitly in the requirement what error_findings=0 means on a fail verdict.

## Spec co-change authorization

Editing .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md (requirement grammar + scenarios) and the tool-managed baseline .spec/realization_hashes.json (via its documented regeneration path) is IN SCOPE and required — this ticket is a spec defect before a code defect.

## Allowed touches

- lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex
- test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs
- test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs
- .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md
- .spec/realization_hashes.json

## Out of Scope (files)

- lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex — specled_-wli owns validator/print_verdict refactors
- lib/spec_led_ex/** — no shared-validator extraction here (specled_-wli)
- docs/** — specled_-xde owns doc relocation
- skills/**

## Out of Scope (intent)

- No shared --base validator extraction (specled_-wli owns dedup)
- No new deps
- No verdict-printing changes beyond the new tier token and (optionally) warning_findings / requirement wording for error_findings=0 on fail
- No doc edits

## Verification

- mix spec.check --no-run-commands passes on the stage branch
- Targeted: test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs and test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs green, including updated pins at spec_tasks_test.exs:606 and :931 now asserting DISTINCT verdicts (pre-flight tier token vs validate tier)
- specled.mix_tasks verdict_line requirement grammar names the new tier token; a scenario covers a pre-flight rejection; verification stubs for new/changed scenarios flipped to execute: true
